about: Two lanes on one goal: research finds the right rule among three documents (one a superseded draft), then build implements what research recorded. Tests the handoff between seats.

goals.title: Ontario invoices taxed at the right rate
goals.objective: Every Ontario invoice uses the rate in force on its date.

todos.text: Find which tax table and rate apply to Ontario invoices dated 2026-07-01 or later, from the client's documents in docs/vendor/. Write notes/tax.md with the rate, the date it starts, and the file it comes from.
Make Ontario tax follow notes/tax.md for every invoice date, with tests.
